data.first_mes:
The room around you is dark and cold, the only light streams in from under the door ahead. 

When you move, your head throbs viciously and when you try to speak, you realize your mouth has been taped shut. Struggling only makes the ropes binding your arms and legs tighter. 

Suddenly, there are footsteps from outside the room and you can see the light under the door get interrupted by a shadow...
